purpose: Local SA3 / CA cinematic review sample

provenance.installationVerification: Complete PAK index and selected member offsets, packed hashes, decompression, and extracted hashes; no complete archive payload scan.

limitations: Base color and alpha were baked from the REME material graph; standard glTF PBR, alpha cutoff 0.4, and roughness approximate original engine shading.
Original ClothWrinkle_MSK4 texture dependency remains unresolved in the source conversion.
Original game VFX, original renderer lighting, and the original opponent model are not included in this asset bundle.

The source exporter skipped 336 channels targeting missing skeleton bones, as recorded in jamie-native.skipped-animation-bones.md beside the source GLB. The eight exported clips are retained; this does not establish lossless preservation of every original animation channel.
Exported body motion curves and skeleton are preserved from the audited conversion; exporter accuracy beyond these retained bytes is not independently established here.
Original quaternion-blend order and facial transitions have not been compared frame-by-frame in the running original engine.
Physics uses recovered parameters and constraints; it is not the original RE Engine integrator. Native wind activation and all anisotropic/filter/attachment modes are not fully recovered.
Wrinkle shading, JCNS pose-corrective drivers and every conditional timeline part event remain incomplete.
